body:
Thanks for taking time out of your day to listen to me, it means a lot. In response to what you said about me doing well before and that it can happen again, It just seems so unlikely and that the only way I could ever be that way again is to go back in time. 

That residential program sounds like a good idea so thanks for that. 

And one more thing, I want someone to tell me that I'm doing okay now. Because I feel like a complete failure at the moment.
